fields.action: The required response or cause resulting from a trigger.
fields.asset: The industrial asset or station identifier.
fields.sensor: The type of sensor measuring the value.
fields.unit: The unit of measurement for the sensor value.
fields.nominal: The target or normal operating range/value.
fields.critical_response: The specific action required when a critical threshold is reached.
fields.zone: The physical area or location of the asset.
fields.condition: The narrative trigger stating when a rule applies.
fields.role: The personnel role associated with the record.
fields.station_dependencies: The sequence or mapping of station dependencies.
fields.depends_on: The specific asset or system that the current asset depends on.
fields.downstream_effect: The impact of a fault on subsequent assets in the process.
fields.station_id: The unique identifier for the station.
fields.trigger: The narrative trigger stating when a rule applies.
fields.priority: The criticality or priority level of the record.
fields.max_persons: The maximum number of persons allowed in a zone.
fields.enforcement: The rules governing how thresholds are enforced or monitored.
fields.prod_area: Indicator if the asset is in the production area.
fields.server_room: Indicator if the asset is in the server room.
fields.gen_warehous_e: Indicator if the asset is in the general warehouse.
fields.main_entranc_e: Indicator if the asset is at the main entrance.
fields.chem_stora_ge: Indicator if the asset is in chemical storage.
fields.r_d_lab: Indicator if the asset is in the R&D lab.
fields.cafeteria: Indicator if the asset is in the cafeteria.
fields.type: The classification of the anomaly (e.g., Spike, Drift).
fields.definition: The technical definition of the anomaly type.
fields.detection_criterion: The mathematical or logical criterion for detecting an anomaly.
fields.ontology_class: The formal ontology classification of the event.
fields.max_ack_warning_min: Maximum allowed time to acknowledge a warning.
fields.max_ack_critical_min: Maximum allowed time to acknowledge a critical alarm.
fields.requirement: The formal mandate or policy requirement.
fields.pattern: The observed relationship or sequence of events across assets.
fields.primary_fault: The root cause or primary failure.
fields.secondary_effect: The resulting failure or symptom caused by the primary fault.
fields.resolution: The step-by-step procedure to resolve the issue.
fields.fault_propagation: Description of how faults move through the system.
fields.correlation: Description of the relationship between two different sensor drifts.
fields.result: The outcome of a specific event or failure.
fields.authorized_personnel: The roles permitted to access a zone or perform an action.
fields.unauthorized_access_action: The action required when unauthorized access is detected.
fields.criterion: The primary basis for a decision or rule.
fields.threshold_hierarchy: The logical ordering of threshold levels.

categories.StaticLimit: Limits that are fixed and not triggered by events.
categories.TriggeredResponse: Actions that occur in response to a specific trigger.
categories.DependencyMapping: Mappings of how assets depend on one another.
categories.AccessConstraint: Rules regarding who can access specific areas.
categories.AnomalyDefinition: Definitions of what constitutes an anomaly.
categories.CorrectiveProcedure: Steps taken to fix a detected issue.
categories.DataRequirement: Requirements for data logging or storage.
